title: AgentOffer Partner Offer Schema v1.0
description: Stable v1.0 Partner supply and configuration artifact. It contains a Partner source identity plus Partner-authored public content, targeting, and conversion configuration; AON inventory identity, dispatch identity, and AON match reasoning are not part of this carrier.

source_offer_id.description: Stable opaque Offer identity assigned by the Partner within the identity namespace configured for this integration. AON resolves owner, namespace, and this value to its own canonical offer_id before ranking or public projection.

version.description: Offer document-model lineage value 3.0; it does not select the transport protocol version.

content_language.description: Language of Partner-authored user-facing Offer copy under the stable-v1.0 language-tag profile; it is not an eligibility constraint.

offer_info.description: Partner-authored user-facing title, description, taxonomy, commercial presentation, rating, and availability data. Operational status, audit, priority, commission settlement, and private eligibility decisions are excluded.

entity.description: Public identity of the merchant, brand, provider, publisher, or other party responsible for the Offer.

listing_source.description: Optional provenance for the external platform or site where the Partner observed the user-facing listing information; it is distinct from entity and action.

action.description: Safe executable destination and user-facing action copy supplied for the Offer.

material.description: Optional non-empty list of HTTPS creative resources and their presentation metadata.

targeting.description: Optional Partner-only eligibility rules. Declared dimensions within one rule are ANDed, rules are ORed, exclusions win, and unknown context fails the affected declared dimension closed. The field is never serialized in a public Offer.

conversion_rule.description: Optional Partner-only attribution and qualification configuration. Omitted members use the stable-v1.0 defaults defined by the Protocol; the field is never serialized in a public Offer.

claims.description: Optional non-empty list of bounded Partner- or source-provided statements. They remain source claims and are not AON endorsements.

goals.description: Unique billable conversion events and the gross Partner-to-AON commission basis declared for each event.

targeting.description: One Partner-only eligibility rule. Declared dimensions are evaluated together with AND; an unknown value for a declared dimension makes this rule fail, while omitted dimensions are unconstrained.

geo.description: Optional geographic inclusion and exclusion constraints. A location matches itself or a descendant in the AON Location Registry; exclusion takes precedence over inclusion.

include.description: Non-empty locations in which this rule can be eligible. When omitted, geography is not positively restricted by an include list.

exclude.description: Non-empty locations made ineligible by this rule. A matching exclusion overrides a matching inclusion.

eligibility.description: Optional Partner-side eligibility constraints that fail closed when the required verified context is unknown.

min_age.description: Minimum verified user age required for this rule. Missing verified age does not satisfy the constraint.

language.description: Optional two-letter lowercase ASCII primary-language eligibility constraint. This profile validates syntax, not ISO 639 registry membership, and is distinct from content_language, which describes Offer copy.

device_type.description: Optional non-empty eligible device classes. Missing or unknown device context does not satisfy this declared constraint.

os.description: Optional non-empty eligible operating systems. Missing or unknown operating-system context does not satisfy this declared constraint.

location.description: Reference to an AON Location Registry v1 entry for Partner eligibility. Numeric grammar is checked structurally and registry membership is checked by the stable-v1.0 semantic validator.

location_id.description: Numeric identifier that must exist in the pinned AON Location Registry v1 snapshot.

conversionRule.description: Partner-only conversion attribution and qualification configuration. Window endpoints are inclusive; zero disables that attribution source. Defaults are click_window_hours=720, view_window_hours=0, attribution_model=last_click, and dedup_strategy=first.

click_window_hours.description: Hours after a qualifying click during which a conversion timestamp is eligible, inclusive of both endpoints. Zero disables click attribution; omission defaults to 720.

view_window_hours.description: Hours after a qualifying view during which a conversion timestamp is eligible, inclusive of both endpoints. Zero disables view-through attribution and is the default.

attribution_model.description: Selects the latest or earliest eligible click; a qualifying click takes precedence over a view, and the same ordering applies to views only when no click qualifies. Omission defaults to last_click.

dedup_strategy.description: Controls distinct business conversions for the same Partner, Offer, Goal, and conversion identity: first accepts only the first qualifying identity, while all accepts every distinct identity. Retries of one identity never count twice. Omission defaults to first.

minimum_amount.description: Optional strictly positive gross conversion-amount threshold. It is valid only for a single-currency integration and is interpreted in that integration's fixed reported conversion currency; multi-currency integrations keep currency-qualified thresholds outside this field.
